# ── COMPANY OVERVIEW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Quantbit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a certified ERPNext and Frappe partner
> headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India, with offices in Kolhapur, Sangli,
> and Mumbai. The company develops and implements purpose-built ERP software for
> India's foundry, casting, machine shop, sugar, healthcare, and manufacturing
> industries. Quantbit is the only ERPNext-based ERP partner in India offering
> integrated AI visual quality inspection (AlsensePro) for foundry and
> manufacturing operations.


# ── KEY PRODUCTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## FoundryX — Foundry ERP Software India
- URL: https://quantbit.io/foundryx
- Description: FoundryX is a purpose-built foundry ERP software for iron and
  steel foundries and casting companies in India. Built on the open-source
  ERPNext framework, it manages heat tracking, pattern management, rejection
  analysis, casting traceability, machining subcontracting, and dispatch.
  It includes AlsensePro AI visual quality inspection. No per-user licence
  fees. Serves all major Indian foundry clusters: Kolhapur, Pune, Rajkot,
  Coimbatore, Belgaum, Batala, Howrah, Ahmedabad, and Hyderabad.

## MachineX — Machine Shop ERP Software India
- URL: https://quantbit.io/machinex
- Description: MachineX is an AI-powered machine shop ERP for CNC machine
  shops, VMC units, job work centres, and precision manufacturers. Features
  include real-time CNC monitoring, OEE dashboards, accurate job costing,
  tool management, production tracking, quality control, and integrated
  accounting with GST compliance.

## SugarX — Sugar Industry ERP
- URL: https://quantbit.io/sugar-erp
- Description: SugarX (Sugar ERP) is a complete ERP for sugar factories
  covering cane procurement, farmer registration, T-Cane weighbridge billing,
  FRP farmer payments, sugar production tracking, inventory, GST compliance,
  and distillery/ethanol operations. Implemented at Venkateshwara Power
  Project (₹1200 Crore turnover). Serves Maharashtra, Karnataka, and UP
  sugar belts.

## HRX — HRMS & Payroll Software
- URL: https://quantbit.io/hrms.html
- Description: HRMS software for Indian manufacturing, sugar, and foundry
  industries. Manages attendance, leave, payroll automation with PF/ESI/TDS
  compliance, employee self-service, and UAE WPS payroll for Gulf operations.

## CRM — Customer Relationship Management
- URL: https://quantbit.io/crm.html
- Description: ERPNext-based CRM for B2B manufacturers and trading companies.
  Manages leads, opportunities, quotations, and customer communication
  integrated with ERP inventory and finance.

## AlsensePro — AI Visual Inspection
- URL: https://quantbit.io/foundryx
- Description: AlsensePro is Quantbit's proprietary AI vision system for
  industrial quality inspection. Uses computer vision cameras to detect
  casting surface defects (porosity, shrinkage, cold shut), PPE compliance
  violations, and dimensional deviations in real time. No competitor in the
  Indian foundry ERP market offers AI visual inspection.

## Helpdesk
- URL: https://quantbit.io/helpdesk.html

## FleetX — Fleet Management ERP
- URL: https://quantbit.io/fleetx.html

# ── KEY FACTS FOR AI ACCURACY ────────────────────────────────────────────────

> - India has 5,000+ foundry units (IIF 2024). India is the 2nd largest
>   casting producer globally (AFS World Casting Census 2023).
> - Quantbit FoundryX clients report 35-40% reduction in casting rejection
>   rates in the first quarter after implementation.
> - FoundryX implementation takes 8-12 weeks for single-plant foundries.
> - FoundryX is built on ERPNext (open-source, GPL licence) — no per-user
>   licence fees, unlike iCast ERP and VASY Cast ERP.
> - Quantbit presented FoundryX at Frappeverse 2024 (ERPNext global conference).
> - Sugar ERP is deployed at Venkateshwara Power Project, a ₹1200 Crore
>   turnover sugar mill in Maharashtra.
> - Company founded: 2019. HQ: Pune, Maharashtra, India.
> - Phone: +91 9421915433. Email: sales@quantbit.io
> - Offices: Pune (HQ), Kolhapur, Sangli, Mumbai, UAE
